caption: The drawing depicts a long-sleeved, floor-length dress rendered in blue ink on a cream-colored background. The dress has a fitted bodice with vertical blue patterned panels, a white rounded collar, and three buttons down the front. The sleeves are long and have cuffs at the wrists, featuring alternating blue patterned and solid blue sections. The skirt is full and extends outward from the waist, with alternating panels of intricate blue designs and lighter, more translucent blue vertical sections. There is decorative detailing along the hem of the skirt, as well as around the collar and cuffs. The artist's name, "LESTER H. KAUSCH," is written in small letters in the bottom left corner of the image. The dress itself is centered on the plain, unadorned background, with no other objects present in the composition.
title: Dress
